title: Natural Deco and More
description: Natural Deco and More adds a bunch of useful natural decor
body:
Natural Deco and More adds 3 types of decor blocks at this current time.
We have log cubbies, mushroom shelves and dripleaf shelves.

More are planned to be released

Current plans
- Branch Shelves
- Rocky Shelves
- Crystalline Shelves
- Rock Cubbies
- Pumpkin Cubby
- Crystalline Cubby
- GlowCoated Mushrooms
- Moonglows and sunglows (flowers)
- Crystal lights

This mod is made with the help of mcreator so may be poorly optimized. As it only adds decoration blocks it should be fine in your worlds and servers. This disclaimer is here for those who like to avoid these kinds of mods.
